body.en:
Key terms: potable supply pipe brings safe water; soil pipe carries toilet discharge; waste pipe carries wastewater from other fixtures; vent pipe protects trap seals and permits air movement. A fixture is a connected appliance such as a water closet, wash basin or sink.

Tools and applications:

  • Pipe wrench and adjustable spanner: grip or turn suitable fittings without excessive force.
  • Pipe cutter and deburring tool: cut and prepare pipe ends for the relevant material.
  • Threading die: form threads on suitable metal pipe; follow the specified joint method.
  • Measuring tape, spirit level and test equipment: set out alignment, slope and verify workmanship.

Use tools appropriate to pipe material; avoid crushing plastic pipe or damaging protective coatings. Isolate the supply before repair.
body.gu:
મુખ્ય terms: Potable supply pipe safe water લાવે છે; soil pipe toilet discharge વહન કરે છે; waste pipe અન્ય fixtures નું wastewater વહન કરે છે; vent pipe trap seals સુરક્ષિત રાખી air movement આપે છે. Fixture એટલે જોડાયેલ appliance જેમ કે water closet, wash basin અથવા sink.

Tools અને applications:

  • Pipe wrench અને adjustable spanner: યોગ્ય fittings ને વધુ બળ વિના પકડવા અથવા ફેરવવા.
  • Pipe cutter અને deburring tool: સંબંધિત material માટે pipe ends કાપવા અને તૈયાર કરવા.
  • Threading die: યોગ્ય metal pipe પર threads બનાવવા; નિર્દિષ્ટ joint method અનુસરો.
  • Measuring tape, spirit level અને test equipment: alignment, slope નક્કી કરવા અને workmanship તપાસવા.

Pipe material પ્રમાણે tools વાપરો; plastic pipe દબાઈ ન જાય અને protective coatings ને નુકસાન ન થાય તેની કાળજી લો. Repair પહેલાં supply isolate કરો.

body.en:
Common fittings: elbow changes direction; tee creates a branch; reducer joins different sizes; coupling connects pipes; union permits disconnection; valve controls flow. Choose approved materials and pressure ratings appropriate to potable water or drainage.

Jointing procedure:

  1. Measure, cut square and prepare pipe ends; remove burrs and debris.
  2. Select the correct gasket, thread sealant, solvent cement or fusion procedure for the approved pipe and fitting system.
  3. Assemble without misalignment; support pipes and allow specified curing or cooling time.
  4. Test for leaks according to the applicable installation standard; flush potable lines and prevent cross-connection.

Solvent cement requires ventilation, fire precautions and manufacturer directions. Never use a drinking-water pipe as an electrical earth connection unless explicitly designed and permitted.
body.gu:
સામાન્ય fittings: Elbow દિશા બદલે છે; tee branch આપે છે; reducer જુદા sizes જોડે છે; coupling pipes જોડે છે; union સરળ disconnection આપે છે; valve flow નિયંત્રિત કરે છે. Potable water અથવા drainage માટે યોગ્ય approved materials અને pressure ratings પસંદ કરો.

Jointing procedure:

  1. Measure કરી pipe ends ચોરસ કાપો અને તૈયાર કરો; burrs તથા debris દૂર કરો.
  2. Approved pipe અને fitting system માટે યોગ્ય gasket, thread sealant, solvent cement અથવા fusion procedure પસંદ કરો.
  3. Misalignment વગર assemble કરો; pipes ને support આપી નિર્દિષ્ટ curing અથવા cooling time આપો.
  4. લાગુ installation standard મુજબ leaks માટે test કરો; potable lines flush કરી cross-connection અટકાવો.

Solvent cement માટે ventilation, fire precautions અને manufacturer directions જરૂરી છે. સ્પષ્ટ રીતે design અને મંજૂર ન હોય તો drinking-water pipe ને electrical earth connection તરીકે કદી ન વાપરો.

body.en:
Trap: a shaped fitting retains a water seal that inhibits sewer gas from entering a building. P-trap outlets are generally horizontal; S-trap outlets are vertical; floor and gully traps collect wastewater at their intended locations. Inspect access and cleanout provisions.

Loss of seal: siphonage, back pressure, evaporation, capillary action, leakage or wind can allow odours and contamination. Proper venting, water supply and maintenance protect the seal; avoid arrangements that can siphon it.

House drainage plan: show fixtures, soil and waste pipes, traps, vents, direction of flow, slopes, inspection chambers, sewer/septic connection and potable-water line. Keep safe separation, accessibility and no cross-connections. Provide approved backflow protection and comply with local plumbing rules.
body.gu:
Trap: આ આકારવાળું fitting water seal જાળવી sewer gas ને building માં આવતાં અટકાવે છે. P-trap outlet સામાન્ય રીતે horizontal અને S-trap outlet vertical છે; floor તથા gully traps નિયત સ્થાને wastewater એકત્ર કરે છે. Access અને cleanout provisions તપાસો.

Seal loss: Siphonage, back pressure, evaporation, capillary action, leakage અથવા wind થી odours અને contamination આવી શકે. યોગ્ય venting, water supply અને maintenance seal ને સુરક્ષિત રાખે છે; seal siphon થાય એવી arrangements ટાળો.

House drainage plan: Fixtures, soil અને waste pipes, traps, vents, flow direction, slopes, inspection chambers, sewer/septic connection અને potable-water line દર્શાવો. Safe separation, accessibility અને cross-connection ન હોય તેની કાળજી લો. Approved backflow protection આપો અને local plumbing rules અનુસરો.

body.en:
Safe practice:

  • Wear suitable eye, hand and foot protection; isolate pressure and electrical hazards before work.
  • Use stable access, protect openings, support excavations and keep the work area ventilated.
  • Do not mix cleaning chemicals; never enter a sewer or septic tank for routine cleaning.
  • Use mechanical cleaning, correct backflow protection and safe wastewater handling; disinfect tools and wash hands afterwards.
  • Test and document work; follow local code, manufacturer instructions and competent supervision.
body.gu:
સલામત practice:

  • યોગ્ય eye, hand અને foot protection પહેરો; કામ પહેલાં pressure અને electrical hazards isolate કરો.
  • Stable access વાપરો, openings સુરક્ષિત કરો, excavations ને support આપો અને કાર્યસ્થળ ventilated રાખો.
  • Cleaning chemicals ભેળવો નહીં; routine cleaning માટે sewer અથવા septic tank માં કદી પ્રવેશ ન કરો.
  • Mechanical cleaning, યોગ્ય backflow protection અને safe wastewater handling વાપરો; પછી tools disinfect કરી હાથ ધુઓ.
  • કામ test કરી નોંધો; local code, manufacturer instructions અને competent supervision અનુસરો.

title.gu: Trap અને water seal ની આકૃતિ
Numerical 9.1 — Drain slope અને fall ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: A house drain has a specified gradient of 1 in 80 and horizontal length 8 m. Find the fall.

Step 1. Calculate the vertical fall.

Fall = horizontal length / 80Fall = 8 / 80Fall = 0.10 m

Step 2. Convert to millimetres.

Fall = 0.10 × 1000

Final answer:

Required fall = 100 mm for this stated gradient; verify the applicable drain design.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: House drain માટે નિર્દિષ્ટ gradient 1 in 80 અને horizontal length 8 m છે. Fall શોધો.

Step 1. Vertical fall ગણો.

Fall = horizontal length / 80Fall = 8 / 80Fall = 0.10 m

Step 2. Millimetres માં ફેરવો.

Fall = 0.10 × 1000

અંતિમ જવાબ:

આપેલ gradient માટે જરૂરી fall = 100 mm; લાગુ drain design તપાસો.
